entry.title: Prewar US business cycles under uncertainty: reconstructing quarterly GDP before 1947
entry.summary:
Official quarterly US GDP estimates begin in 1947; earlier quarterly histories must be reconstructed using annual benchmarks and historical indicators. To investigate uncertainty in these reconstructions, this paper systematically compares specifications drawn from the literature for reconstructing quarterly GDP during 1919–1946. The comparison evaluates predictions on concealed postwar quarters and separates variation across specifications from coefficient uncertainty within a model.

Source: Bank for International Settlements (BIS Research) · Tags: #monetary-policy #quant-finance

entry.title: Building AI on credit: structures and spillovers
entry.summary:
Capital expenditure to build artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure is growing fast, and a rising share is financed with long-term debt and through complex off-balance sheet arrangements.

entry.title: Chokepoints in global supply chains: lessons from rare earths and hard disk drives
entry.summary:
Concentration and limited substitutability can turn the efficiency gains from global supply chains into vulnerabilities. However, the consequences of chokepoints depend on their underlying nature.
